scripts.check:worker: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config ../../apps/web/wrangler.jsonc --env staging --dry-run
scripts.dev:worker: npm run build && wrangler dev --config ../../apps/web/wrangler.jsonc --env staging --local --ip 127.0.0.1
scripts.deploy:staging: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config ../../apps/web/wrangler.jsonc --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: npm run build && wrangler deploy --config ../../apps/web/wrangler.jsonc --env production
